title: Translating technical risk into business risk

videos.script: Every week the CEO hears that something is urgent. Sales brings a number. Marketing brings a number. Engineering brings an adjective. {{title}} Fragile. Risky. Doesn't scale. None of it is false, and it still loses, because an adjective cannot be weighed against a number. {{words}} This lesson turns a technical risk into the kind of sentence that gets a budget. Two numbers first: how likely it is, and what it costs when it happens. {{grid}} Then the arithmetic, line by line, with a source for every number. Including the number that cut Lívia's estimate by more than half, and made the rest believable. {{table}} Then options with prices, so the decider chooses instead of worrying. Doing nothing is one of the options. {{options}} And finally, how to say how sure you are. A range, and what it rests on.
